title: artemisia campestris var. wormskioldii
intro: Artemisia campestris var. wormskioldii, commonly known as Wormwood, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Wormwood include its use as an antimalarial, antiparasitic, and anti-inflammatory agent, as well as its ability to stimulate the appetite and relieve symptoms of fever. The bioactive constituents of Wormwood include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, such as thujone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
